name: J1613-3736
notes: Extremely compact Class II disk; ALMA Band 7 0.87 mm (Curone et al. 2026)

images.wavelength_label: 0.87 mm continuum (343.5 GHz; robust 0.5; compact, hint of a 3-4 au plateau)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Panel label inside figure: J16134410. R68 = 4.54 au (0.0289"). No resolved gap/ring in the image; visibility curvature is fitted by frank as a plateau-like feature at 3-4 au, but it is not robust against the geometric-parameter Monte Carlo, so it is classified only as a hint. Low-SNR extended emission around the central peak. Beam 20x13 mas = 3.1x2.0 au, PA_b = 74 deg; F_nu = 1.83 +/- 0.20 mJy; rms 20 uJy/beam. EBs 23 Jul and 29 Jul 2025 (1 h on-source); epoch = first EB.
